'''Adar 20 (May 2)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*{{ne|998}} - [[Rand al'Thor]] and [[Matrim Cauthon]] arrive in [[Caemlyn]] at dawn. [[Basel Gill]] gives them a room at The [[Queen's Blessing]]. Rand meets [[Loial]] in the library. [[Moiraine Damodred]], [[Lan Mandragoran]] and [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] find the [[Whitecloak]]s' camp. They rescue [[Perrin Aybara]] and [[Egwene al'Vere]]. Nynaeve discovers Perrin's eyes are turning yellow.
*{{ne|999}} - Perrin's party arrive in [[Illian]]. At [[Nieda Sidoro]]'s inn, [[Easing the Badger]], they are attacked by [[Gray Men]]. Moiraine discovers that Lord Brend is [[Sammael]]. They leave Illian during a storm, chased and attacked by [[Darkhounds]]. Approaching [[Caemlyn]], Mat and [[Thomdril Merrilin]] are attacked by [[Darkfriends]].
